feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Desktop and apps on Windows Server 2022

entry.title: Now fixed: USB audio devices might fail to start or produce no sound
entry.summary: Started with KB5122882. Fixed in KB5129237. Affects: Windows Server 2022. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-server-2022#4984msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.
